scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
No words for noob!! Level 40 below cannot join Singles Union Army!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
新手退散！！
等级低于40级的玩家无法加入单身联盟军！

scripts.text: ^ff0000You are overweight. Check your inventory and speak to me later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000你超重了。请整理你的背包，稍后再来找我。^000000

scripts.text: - You can repeat this quest after 24 hours.
scripts.translation: - 24小时后你可以重复此任务。

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
We need more materials to hold a Christmas party for the Singles Union Army!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
我们需要更多材料，才能为单身联盟军举办圣诞派对！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Bring ^ff000010 Stolen Cookie, 10 Stolen Candy, and 10 Bag Of Selling Goods^000000 from those damn raccoons!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
去从那些该死的浣熊那里抢回^ff000010个被偷窃的饼干、10个被偷窃的糖果和10个出售用商品袋^000000！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Did you kick the ass of the Raccoon Hooray team? Oh! You've brought all the items we need. We will be able to feel some Christmas mood with it!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
你击败了浣熊欢腾队？哦！你带来了我们需要的所有物品。有了它们，我们就能感受到圣诞的气氛了！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
I will take ALL the items you brought. For that, I'll give you an exclusive reward only for Singles Union Army. You-must-open-it-ALONE!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
我会收下你带来的所有物品。作为回报，我会给你一份仅限单身联盟军成员的专属奖励。你必须独自打开它！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Seize the holiday!
Glory to the Singles Union Army! hihihi HAHAHAHA!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
享受这个节日吧！
单身联盟军万岁！嘻嘻嘻 哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
You have a total of {0} couple breaking points.
Break up at least 5 couples and come back to me!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
你目前共有{0}点拆散情侣点数。
至少拆散5对情侣，然后回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Yes! You did it!! More and more are joining the Singles Union Army!! hihihi HAHAHA-HAK! Victory is ours!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
是的！你做到了！！越来越多的人加入了单身联盟军！！嘻嘻嘻 哈哈哈-哈！胜利属于我们！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
BUT!!! While we're busy breaking up couples, those damn Raccoon Hooray brats stole most of our items. Without it, we cannot get the feel of Christmas mood.
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
但是！！！就在我们忙着拆散情侣的时候，那些该死的浣熊欢腾队偷走了我们的大部分物品。没有它们，我们就无法感受到圣诞的气氛。

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
It's time to punish them and reclaim the items for the Singles Union Army!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
是时候惩罚他们，为单身联盟军夺回物品了！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
^ff0000>10 Stolen Cookie, 10 Stolen Candy and 10 Bag Of Selling Goods^000000 should be enough for the party. Find the raccoons on field maps and dungeons!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
^ff0000>10个被偷窃的饼干、10个被偷窃的糖果和10个出售用商品袋^000000应该足够举办派对了。去野外地图和副本里找浣熊吧！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
It doesn't matter if you brought more, I will take them ALL!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
不管你带了多少，我都会全部收下！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Hey you!! Yes! You right there! You!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
嘿，你！对，就是你！你！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Let me ask you bluntly.
You must be single. I've got a feeling. Right?!??
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
让我直说吧。
你肯定是单身。我有这种感觉。对吧？！？

scripts.text: WHAT! I'm in a relationship!!
scripts.translation: 什么！我有对象！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
What? ...in a relationship?!!
...Not single, but a couple...
......
Damn you! Taste the wrath of the Singles Union Army!!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
什么？...有对象？！！
...不是单身，而是情侣...
......
该死！尝尝单身联盟军的怒火吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!
I knew it! First glance I can tell!
Don't underestimate me, I've been single all my life! hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!
My name is Union Commander Cliff!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
嘻嘻嘻 哈哈哈-哈！
我就知道！我一眼就能看出来！
别小看我，我单身一辈子了！嘻嘻嘻 哈哈哈-哈！
我的名字是联盟指挥官 克里夫！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Anyway, this December, the day is coming....
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
总之，这个十二月，那一天就要到了...

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Christmas songs everywhere, bright colored lights, pouring white snow, and couples seeing each other with smile on their faces...couples...COUPPPLEEES...!!!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
到处都是圣诞歌曲，五颜六色的彩灯，纷纷扬扬的白雪，还有脸上挂着笑容的情侣们...情侣...情侣啊...！！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
In the beginning was a celebration of the birth of our Lord! Then, why...how...when did it became a day for couples??!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
起初，这是庆祝我们主诞生的节日！那么，为什么...怎么...什么时候变成了情侣的节日呢？！？

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
I can't stand this....
I will not forgive them for the happiness they bring only for themselves!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
我受不了了...
他们只为自己带来幸福，我绝不原谅他们！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Christmas for couples?
No way! This Christmas will be a day for singles!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
情侣的圣诞节？
没门！这个圣诞节将是单身者的节日！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
However, I will need members to stand against them. Its name would be, Singles Union Army!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
不过，我需要成员们站出来对抗他们。它的名字是，单身联盟军！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
What do you think? Would you join my Singles Union Army and make Christmas day for singles?
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
你觉得怎么样？你愿意加入我的单身联盟军，让圣诞节成为单身者的节日吗？

scripts.text: Count me in!
scripts.translation: 算我一个！

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我会帮忙的。

scripts.text: I can't say no, can I?
scripts.translation: 我没法拒绝，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Yeah! That's it! but we need more members to stand against couples.
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
没错！就是这样！但我们还需要更多成员来对抗情侣。

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Here is your first mission!
Go find someone in Lutie and make them join us. 5 singles should be enough, now gogogo~!
hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!

[联盟指挥官 克里夫]

去姜饼城找个人，让他们加入我们。5个单身者就足够了，现在出发出发出发~！
嘻嘻嘻 哈哈哈-哈！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
No time to waste!
Go find 5 singles in Lutie and make them join!

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Good job! I've met them all! They are worthy to join our cause hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
While you were gathering more Singles Union Army members, I've made badges..
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
It might not be useful but this kind of small token can make our bonds solid and strong!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
虽然可能没什么用，但这种小信物能让我们的纽带更加牢固！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Well, take this! Now you are the proud member of Singles Union Army!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
好了，拿着这个！现在你是单身联盟军自豪的成员了！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Now it is time to show our power to couples as we've got enough members!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
现在是我们向情侣展示力量的时候了，因为我们已经有足够的成员了！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
On to the second mission!
Go to Lutie and make couples separate. Doesn't matter how you do it, just them break up!!
hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
进入第二个任务！
去姜饼城让情侣们分手。不管用什么方法，只要让他们分手就行！！
嘻嘻嘻 哈哈哈-哈！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Well there is one more thing...
When you disturb couple, if they broke up, you will gain 2 point, in case of just simple argument will grant you 1 point.
But if they become more into each others, your score will be minus 1 point. So when you got 5 points and come here for report, it means mission accomplished.
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
还有一件事...
当你打扰情侣时，如果他们分手了，你会获得2分；如果只是简单的争吵，你会获得1分。
但如果他们因此更加相爱，你的分数会减1分。所以当你获得5分并回来汇报时，就意味着任务完成。

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Surely you won't have minus score so don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
放心吧，你的分数不会变成负数的。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
Actually, I have something to tell you.
It's very important so please listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
其实，我有件事想告诉你。
非常重要，请仔细听。

scripts.text:
[Florist]
Oh, sure, please speak freely.
scripts.translation:
[花店老板]
哦，当然，请说。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
Biologically speaking, limbic system in the cerebrum enables us to be sociable, to communicate with people, to entertain etc.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
从生物学角度来说，大脑中的边缘系统让我们能够社交、与人交流、享受娱乐等。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
So when you see a beautiful woman, the information such as her appearance, her scent, the tone of her voice etc. goes to the limbic area.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
所以当你看到一位美丽的女性时，她的外貌、气味、声音语调等信息都会传送到边缘系统。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
The limbic system then evaluates the information, to see if this lady is friendly, agressive, or charming, etc.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
然后边缘系统会评估这些信息，判断这位女士是友善、具有攻击性，还是迷人等。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
When the evaluation is done, the limbic system immediately begins to secrete the chemicals.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
评估完成后，边缘系统会立即开始分泌化学物质。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
So if you're attracted to this lady, a hormone calls Dopamine is secreted and it makes you feel slightly happy.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
如果你被这位女士吸引，就会分泌一种名为多巴胺的激素，让你感到微微快乐。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
When that stage ends, you get the Adrenaline pumping, then you become more direct and enthusiastic.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
当那个阶段结束后，肾上腺素开始泵动，你会变得更加直接和热情。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
I'm in that stage now towards you! In other word, I am very...!!
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
我现在对你就处于那个阶段！换句话说，我非常...！！
